# A test reaches the copies of an `#id` under a `for` through a map each
# render starts afresh, and each instance the render keeps stamps its copy
# again from the setter of its index (lower.clearCopies). A setter handed the
# value its cell holds returns before the write (lower.propSetter), so the
# rows kept stamped nothing and only the row the render added was reached: the
# Pokédex's Sprites tests found no label at 4. The setter stamps before it
# returns. A golden's run of the same test passed without the stamp; `sngl
# test` fails it.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

struct Sprite {
    label string
    url   string
}

component page ui.node {
    var pics = [Sprite{label="a", url="x"}, Sprite{label="b", url="y"}]

    ui.vbox {
        for var p = pics {
            ui.vbox {
                ui.image(alt=p.label) {
                    ui.remote(url=p.url)
                }
                ui.text #spriteLabel(value=p.label)
            }
        }
        ui.button #more(text="more", @click { pics.push(Sprite{label="c", url="z"}) })
    }
}

func testEveryCopyIsReachedAfterARender(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.spriteLabel[0] != null && c.spriteLabel[0].value == "a")
    t.assert(c.spriteLabel[1] != null && c.spriteLabel[1].value == "b")
    t.assert(c.spriteLabel[2] != null && c.spriteLabel[2].value == "c")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
